name: KITE HILL
author: ashtonwallen (built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal)
tagline: Windy hilltop full of kites. Every line hums a note; the weather plays them.
description: KITE HILL turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into a windy hilltop that plays itself. Each kite line hums a note from the hill's tuning set: kites climb in steady wind and sink in lulls, so their notes swell and fade, and a gust lifts them all together. New kites go up on new notes; now and then one breaks loose and drifts away on a falling tone. The day turns from a still morning to a gusty evening, the harmony moving through a short ring of chords, and each new day in a near key. A low drone, a wind bed on its own Ambience level. Twelve hills, from Chalk Horse to Uncle's Diamond; keys send up a kite.
credits: Built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal, on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
